PORT.description: Port the container listens on (mapped to OPENBB_API_PORT by the entrypoint).

OPENBB_API_AUTH.description: Enable HTTP Basic auth on the API (true/false). false = open access.

OPENBB_API_PASSWORD.description: Basic-auth password (only used when OPENBB_API_AUTH=true). Auto-generated.

FRED_API_KEY.description: FRED API key for macro/market data.

POLYGON_API_KEY.description: Polygon.io API key for equity/ETF/FX market data.
